name: historical_option_data
status: DRAFT: implemented in Phase 2 (src/niftypaper/historical) and exercised on invented fixtures only; no real market data has been ingested. Field names may still change.
principles: Raw source files are kept unchanged and hashed; canonical records are derived from them and always point back (file, hash, row).
A missing value is null. Nothing is estimated, interpolated, forward-filled or taken from another source.
A source value that means 'no trade' (UDiFF 0.00, contract-wise '-') becomes null in the canonical price fields and sets a quality flag; the raw value stays in the raw file.

Record kinds are separate types. Only QUOTE_SNAPSHOT can be a fill source, and only with a documented quote time. EOD, bar and settlement records have no bid or ask field at all, so they cannot be mistaken for quotes.
Every record says when it became knowable (available_at). A replay may use a record only at or after that instant.
Rejected, conflicting and excluded records are never dropped silently: each gets an EXCLUSION entry.

contract_key.note: The natural key. A source instrument id (for example the UDiFF FinInstrmId) is stored but is NOT a key: it was reused for different contracts at different times in the local files.

source_file.note: path relative to the raw store

source_content_sha256.note: hash of the CSV inside a zip, so copies in different wrappers can be compared

retrieved_at_utc.note: from the download log; null when the file was placed by hand and no log exists

EOD_CONTRACT_DAY.description: One contract on one trading day from an end-of-day file (UDiFF bhavcopy or the contract-wise download). Settlement and closing information, not quotes.

underlying.source: UDiFF TckrSymb (index options: FinInstrmTp = IDO); contract-wise: Symbol

observed_at.note: always null: these files carry no time of day

available_at.rule: trading_date 23:59:59 IST (conservative; the exact publication time is not verified)

close.note: for a contract that did not trade this is a carried-forward value, flagged CLOSE_CARRIED_NO_TRADE

last_price.note: on zero-volume rows UDiFF can show the previous close here (flag LAST_CARRIED_NO_TRADE); it evidences a trade only when volume is above zero

traded.rule: true if reported volume or transactions are above zero; null if neither is reported

volume.source: UDiFF TtlTradgVol; contract-wise: No. of contracts

volume_unit.note: NIFTY option volumes in the UDiFF files are not multiples of the lot size (9 of 1,059 traded rows on 2026-06-05 were) and turnover divided by volume is about lot size x strike, so they look like contracts (lots); stock-option rows looked like units. Inferred from the numbers, not from a definition: flag VOLUME_UNIT_INFERRED.

turnover_value.note: in the UDiFF files turnover divided by volume is about lot size x strike for NIFTY options, so it looks like notional value rather than premium paid; the contract-wise download has separate Turnover and Premium Turnover columns. The official field definitions (the 'New Bhavcopy Format readme') have not been read; never use it for cost modelling

lot_size.source: UDiFF NewBrdLotQty; absent from the contract-wise download (flag LOT_SIZE_ABSENT)

tick_size.note: not present in either file: always null here (flag TICK_SIZE_ABSENT)

INTRADAY_BAR.description: An OHLCV candle from a broker API. Good for signals; its close is not a price anyone could trade at.

timestamp_convention.note: what the provider's candle timestamp means; UNKNOWN sets INTERVAL_TIMESTAMP_CONVENTION_UNKNOWN

QUOTE_SNAPSHOT.description: A bid and ask at an instant. The only kind that can ever be a fill source, and only when the time is a documented quote time. No current dataset contains any.
QUOTE_SNAPSHOT.fill_eligibility_rule: time_semantics is QUOTE_TIME, 0 < bid < ask, both on the tick, lot_size and tick_size present; at replay time the V6-0.1 eligibility boundary must also pass (displayed sizes, freshness against the replay clock).

CONTRACT_SPEC.description: Lot size and tick size of an underlying's options over a period, with how well each is known.

EXCLUSION.description: Why a source record is not in the canonical set. One entry per excluded record.

other_copy.note: file and row of the record that was kept or that conflicts

duplicate_and_conflict_policy.key: (record_kind, contract_key, trading_date or bar_start or observed_at, source_id)
duplicate_and_conflict_policy.identical_copies: Records with the same key and identical values (same source_content_sha256 for whole files) are duplicates. Keep the copy that sorts first by (relative path, source_file_sha256); every other copy gets an EXCLUSION of DUPLICATE_OF_EARLIER_COPY naming the kept copy.
duplicate_and_conflict_policy.conflicting_copies: Records with the same key and different values are a conflict. Exclude ALL of them (CONFLICTING_COPIES / CONFLICTING_ROW_IN_FILE) and list them; never prefer the newest, the largest or the first. A person resolves it and records the decision.
duplicate_and_conflict_policy.across_sources: Different source_id values are never merged and never used to fill each other's gaps.
duplicate_and_conflict_policy.ordering: Deterministic: files are processed in sorted path order and rows in file order, so the same inputs always give the same outputs.

raw_store.layout: data/raw/{source_id}/{original file name} plus data/raw/{source_id}/MANIFEST.jsonl with one line per file: relative path, sha256, bytes, retrieved_at_utc (or null), origin (url or 'manual download'), terms_url, terms_checked_on.
rules: Files are copied in unchanged and never edited.
A file whose hash differs from its MANIFEST line is rejected with HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_MANIFEST.
The store lives under data/ (git-ignored), never under the research folder.
